summary: Flathead County, MT ground site on Forster Mountain: L-4 cab dated 1940 and abandoned 1948 per firelookout.com; listed gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab half a mile south of the summit
facts.status_note: firelookout.com says 'Abandoned 1948. Gone.'; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Ground, Gone

events.note: firelookout.com dates the L-4 cab to 1940

evidence.supports: about eight miles southeast of Essex
L-4 cab dated 1940, half a mile south of the summit
evidence.quote: 1940: L-4 cab 1/2 mile south of the summit.

evidence.supports: firelookout.com calls it a fire lookout cabin (page title)
places it in the Flathead National Forest
classed as a Ground site, marked Gone, at 48.18753, -113.49350

notes_for_editor: Every date (1940 build, 1948 abandonment) comes from firelookout.com alone. Forest Lookouts gives only the legal location and agency. Two searches found nothing more on this site. The brief's coordinates and agency match the Association's list. The Flathead National Forest records or Hungry Horse News archives could confirm the dates.
